583: impl AsyncRead for File {
584:     fn poll_read(
585:         self: Pin<&mut Self>,
586:         cx: &mut Context<'_>,
587:         dst: &mut ReadBuf<'_>,
588:     ) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
589:         ready!(crate::trace::trace_leaf(cx));
590:         let me = self.get_mut();
591:         let inner = me.inner.get_mut();
592: 
593:         loop {
594:             match inner.state {
595:                 State::Idle(ref mut buf_cell) => {
596:                     let mut buf = buf_cell.take().unwrap();
597: 
598:                     if !buf.is_empty() {
599:                         buf.copy_to(dst);
600:                         *buf_cell = Some(buf);
601:                         return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
602:                     }
603: 
604:                     let std = me.std.clone();
605:                     let dst_capacity = dst.buf.len();
606:                     let dst_filled = dst.filled;
607:                     let dst_remaining = if dst_capacity > dst_filled {
608:                         dst_capacity - dst_filled
609:                     } else {
610:                         0
611:                     };
612: 
613:                     let configured_max = me.max_buf_size;
614:                     let max_buf_size = if dst_remaining > configured_max {
615:                         configured_max
616:                     } else {
617:                         dst_remaining
618:                     };
619: 
620:                     inner.state = State::Busy(spawn_blocking(move || {
621:                         let current_len = buf.buf.len();
622:                         let current_pos = buf.pos;
623:                         let logical_len = if current_len > current_pos {
624:                             current_len - current_pos
625:                         } else {
626:                             0
627:                         };
628:                         assert_eq!(logical_len, 0);
629: 
630:                         buf.buf.reserve(max_buf_size);
631:                         let spare = buf.buf.spare_capacity_mut();
632:                         let uninit = &mut spare[..max_buf_size];
633:                         let slice = unsafe {
634:                             &mut *(uninit as *mut [MaybeUninit<u8>] as *mut [u8])
635:                         };
636: 
637:                         let read_res = loop {
638:                             match std::io::Read::read(&mut &*std, slice) {
639:                                 Err(ref err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {
640:                                     continue;
641:                                 }
642:                                 Err(err) => break Err(err),
643:                                 Ok(read_n) => break Ok(read_n),
644:                             }
645:                         };
646: 
647:                         let res = match read_res {
648:                             Ok(n) => {
649:                                 unsafe {
650:                                     buf.buf.set_len(n);
651:                                 }
652:                                 assert_eq!(buf.pos, 0);
653:                                 Ok(n)
654:                             }
655:                             Err(err) => {
656:                                 buf.buf.clear();
657:                                 assert_eq!(buf.pos, 0);
658:                                 Err(err)
659:                             }
660:                         };
661:                         (Operation::Read(res), buf)
662:                     }));
663:                 }
664:                 State::Busy(ref mut rx) => {
665:                     let (op, mut buf) = match Pin::new(rx).poll(cx) {
666:                         Poll::Pending => return Poll::Pending,
667:                         Poll::Ready(Err(join_err)) => {
668:                             let io_err: io::Error = join_err.into();
669:                             match io_err.kind() {
670:                                 io::ErrorKind::Other => return Poll::Ready(Err(io_err)),
671:                                 io::ErrorKind::Interrupted => {
672:                                     return Poll::Ready(Err(io_err))
673:                                 }
674:                                 io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => {
675:                                     return Poll::Ready(Err(io_err))
676:                                 }
677:                                 _ => return Poll::Ready(Err(io_err)),
678:                             }
679:                         }
680:                         Poll::Ready(Ok(pair)) => pair,
681:                     };
682: 
683:                     match op {
684:                         Operation::Read(Ok(_read_n)) => {
685:                             let buf_len = buf.buf.len();
686:                             let buf_pos = buf.pos;
687:                             let available = if buf_len > buf_pos {
688:                                 buf_len - buf_pos
689:                             } else {
690:                                 0
691:                             };
692:                             let dst_capacity = dst.buf.len();
693:                             let dst_filled = dst.filled;
694:                             let dst_initialized = dst.initialized;
695:                             let space = if dst_capacity > dst_filled {
696:                                 dst_capacity - dst_filled
697:                             } else {
698:                                 0
699:                             };
700:                             let n_copy = if available > space {
701:                                 space
702:                             } else {
703:                                 available
704:                             };
705:                             let init_space = if dst_initialized > dst_filled {
706:                                 dst_initialized - dst_filled
707:                             } else {
708:                                 0
709:                             };
710: 
711:                             if n_copy == 0 {
712:                                 if buf_pos == buf_len {
713:                                     if buf.buf.is_empty() {
714:                                         buf.pos = 0;
715:                                     } else {
716:                                         buf.buf.truncate(0);
717:                                         buf.pos = 0;
718:                                     }
719:                                 }
720:                                 inner.state = State::Idle(Some(buf));
721:                                 return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
722:                             }
723: 
724:                             if n_copy <= init_space {
725:                                 if n_copy <= 64 {
726:                                     let src = &buf.buf[buf_pos..buf_pos + n_copy];
727:                                     let end = dst_filled + n_copy;
728:                                     unsafe {
729:                                         dst.buf[dst_filled..end]
730:                                             .as_mut_ptr()
731:                                             .cast::<u8>()
732:                                             .copy_from_nonoverlapping(src.as_ptr(), n_copy);
733:                                     }
734:                                     dst.filled = end;
735:                                 } else {
736:                                     let chunk_size = if n_copy <= 4096 { 512 } else { 8192 };
737:                                     let mut offset = 0;
738:                                     while offset < n_copy {
739:                                         let remaining_copy = n_copy - offset;
740:                                         let chunk = if remaining_copy > chunk_size {
741:                                             chunk_size
742:                                         } else {
743:                                             remaining_copy
744:                                         };
745:                                         let src_start = buf_pos + offset;
746:                                         let src = &buf.buf[src_start..src_start + chunk];
747:                                         let start = dst_filled + offset;
748:                                         let end = start + chunk;
749:                                         unsafe {
750:                                             dst.buf[start..end]
751:                                                 .as_mut_ptr()
752:                                                 .cast::<u8>()
753:                                                 .copy_from_nonoverlapping(
754:                                                     src.as_ptr(),
755:                                                     chunk,
756:                                                 );
757:                                         }
758:                                         offset += chunk;
759:                                     }

part.text:
Fixed in tokio/src/fs/file.rs:598. When `poll_read` is called with a zero-capacity destination buffer, `File::poll_read` now returns `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately instead of spawning a background read of 0 bytes (which was then misinterpreted as EOF on the next poll). This matches the `AsyncRead` contract and the upstream tokio fix.

Validation:
- `tokio --test fs_file`: all 17 tests pass, including the FAIL_TO_PASS `empty_read` test that covers exactly this scenario.
- Related io tests (`io_buf_reader`, `io_read`, `io_read_buf`, `io_read_to_end`, `io_take`, `io_copy`, `io_lines`, `io_split`, `io_panic`) and all 28 lib `fs` unit tests pass.
- `fs_try_exists` fails, but it fails identically on the pristine tree (environmental, unrelated to this change).
